source.snippet: I have tried querying numerous objects and limited my query to just one record and workbench is not responding. I have waited 5+ minutes for a query result with no luck. I've cleared my cookies/cache, logged out, and tried both versions 67 and 68. Other users on my team are observing the same behavior.

problem_statement: Salesforce admins and developers rely on Workbench as a critical query and data-management tool, but it suffers from unpredictable outages or hangs that block entire teams with no reliable alternative or status visibility.
target_segment: Salesforce administrators and developers at businesses of all sizes who use Workbench for SOQL queries, data loads, and metadata operations.
notes: Team-wide Workbench failure blocking multiple paid Salesforce org users simultaneously. Salesforce environments are enterprise paid contexts — these are professional users whose work is blocked. The underlying opportunity is a more reliable, self-hosted or SaaS alternative to Workbench with status monitoring. Existing tools (DataLoader, VS Code extension) don't replicate Workbench's browser-based convenience. Buyer: Salesforce admins/developers at companies paying for Salesforce licenses. Willingness to pay for a stable tool is implied by the business context.
